name: gettext
description: The Gettext package contains utilities for internationalization and localization. These allow programs to be compiled with NLS (Native Language Support), enabling them to output messages in the user's native language.

installed_descriptions.name: autopoint
installed_descriptions.description: Copies standard Gettext infrastructure files into a source package

installed_descriptions.name: envsubst
installed_descriptions.description: Substitutes environment variables in shell format strings

installed_descriptions.name: gettext
installed_descriptions.description: Translates a natural language message into the user's language by looking up the translation in a message catalog

installed_descriptions.name: gettext.sh
installed_descriptions.description: Primarily serves as a shell function library for gettext

installed_descriptions.name: gettextize
installed_descriptions.description: Copies all standard Gettext files into the given top-level directory of a package to begin internationalizing it

installed_descriptions.name: msgattrib
installed_descriptions.description: Filters the messages of a translation catalog according to their attributes and manipulates the attributes

installed_descriptions.name: msgcat
installed_descriptions.description: Concatenates and merges the given .po files

installed_descriptions.name: msgcmp
installed_descriptions.description: Compares two .po files to check that both contain the same set of msgid strings

installed_descriptions.name: msgcomm
installed_descriptions.description: Finds the messages that are common to the given .po files

installed_descriptions.name: msgconv
installed_descriptions.description: Converts a translation catalog to a different character encoding

installed_descriptions.name: msgen
installed_descriptions.description: Creates an English translation catalog

installed_descriptions.name: msgexec
installed_descriptions.description: Applies a command to all translations of a translation catalog

installed_descriptions.name: msgfilter
installed_descriptions.description: Applies a filter to all translations of a translation catalog

installed_descriptions.name: msgfmt
installed_descriptions.description: Generates a binary message catalog from a translation catalog

installed_descriptions.name: msggrep
installed_descriptions.description: Extracts all messages of a translation catalog that match a given pattern or belong to some given source files

installed_descriptions.name: msginit
installed_descriptions.description: Creates a new .po file, initializing the meta information with values from the user's environment

installed_descriptions.name: msgmerge
installed_descriptions.description: Combines two raw translations into a single file

installed_descriptions.name: msgunfmt
installed_descriptions.description: Decompiles a binary message catalog into raw translation text

installed_descriptions.name: msguniq
installed_descriptions.description: Unifies duplicate translations in a translation catalog

installed_descriptions.name: ngettext
installed_descriptions.description: Displays native language translations of a textual message whose grammatical form depends on a number

installed_descriptions.name: recode-sr-latin
installed_descriptions.description: Recodes Serbian text from Cyrillic to Latin script

installed_descriptions.name: xgettext
installed_descriptions.description: Extracts the translatable message lines from the given source files to make the first translation template

installed_descriptions.name: libasprintf
installed_descriptions.description: Defines the autosprintf class, which makes C formatted output routines usable in C++ programs, for use with the <string> strings and the <iostream> streams

installed_descriptions.name: libgettextlib
installed_descriptions.description: Contains common routines used by the various Gettext programs; these are not intended for general use

installed_descriptions.name: libgettextpo
installed_descriptions.description: Used to write specialized programs that process .po files; this library is used when the standard applications shipped with Gettext (such as msgcomm, msgcmp, msgattrib, and msgen) will not suffice

installed_descriptions.name: libgettextsrc
installed_descriptions.description: Provides common routines used by the various Gettext programs; these are not intended for general use

installed_descriptions.name: libtextstyle
installed_descriptions.description: Text styling library

installed_descriptions.name: preloadable_libintl
installed_descriptions.description: A library, intended to be used by LD_PRELOAD, that helps libintl log untranslated messages
